moat_against: Housing-cycle beta: volumes and plant utilization swing with US housing; FY26 Siding & Trim EBITDA margin compressed ~400bp on underutilization
Cheaper substitutes (vinyl ~25-30% of siding, wood, stucco) cap pricing in a downturn
ROIC fading pre-deal: 23.4% FY22 → 20.5% FY23 → 19.8% FY24 → 15.9% FY25 → 2.1% FY26 (fundamentals.json roic_proxy); gross margin 40.4% FY24 → 35.8% FY26
AZEK leverage and integration: net debt $4.27B (was $0.56B pre-deal); decking faces Trex head-on
Legacy asbestos funding obligation (AICF) is a permanent cash drag unique to Hardie
Capital-intensive: capex $258-591M/yr over the last five fiscal years
moat_for: ~90% share of North American fiber cement; Hardie brand is the category
National multi-year builder agreements and deep dealer/channel partnerships
Proven pricing power — ASP +2% in a weak housing market (Q2 FY26)
Repair & remodel ~60-65% of demand — less cyclical than new construction
Material-conversion runway: fiber cement on only ~8% of existing US homes; $23B conversion opportunity cited at Sept 2026 Investor Day
AZEK adds leading composite deck/rail brand and exterior cross-sell; $125M cost synergies tracking a year ahead of schedule
moat_justification: ~90% North American fiber-cement share, the Hardie brand, national builder agreements and proven pricing power (ASP +2% in a weak Q2 FY26 market), with repair/remodel ~60-65% of demand softening the cycle and AZEK adding the leading composite decking brand — against housing cyclicality, cheaper vinyl/wood substitutes, Trex competition in decking, a legacy asbestos funding obligation, and pre-AZEK ROIC already fading from 23.4% (FY22) to 15.9% (FY25) before collapsing to 2.1% in the FY26 acquisition trough.
name: James Hardie Industries plc
one_liner: Dominant fiber-cement franchise, moat 6/10, transformed and levered by the $8.75B AZEK deal — at $25.82 the market is paying for synergies and a housing recovery, but TTM owner's earnings of $0.54/share support only a 5.1% weighted IRR (weighted IV@15% $5.02); it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$5.
sector: Building Products / Fiber cement & exterior solutions
